newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair undecided on fare hike.
newsitem.headline: Swissair undecided on fare hike.

text.p: Swiss carrier Swissair AG said it had not yet taken any decision on whether to raise European fares in response to rising fuel costs.
"We are studying the possibility of price changes but no decision have been taken," Swissair spokesman Herbert Schmell said in response to an enquiry.

British Airways Plc said Wednesday that it was increasing full published rares on its European routes by 2.5 percent on average from the middle of October as a direct consequence of soaring jet fuel costs.
Several other airlines in Europe, as well as American Airlines parent AMR Corp in the U.S., also said they were taking similar steps on pricing.
